cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lead the festival bid. Tell the committee to pencil us in for June; we'll decide the budget afterwards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not announcing a festival we can't afford.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just ask them to hold the date. I'll make the announcement if we go ahead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll want a name responsible for the booking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give them mine. Once June's held, bring me the cheapest way we can fill it.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 name and cheapest-plan request are practical consequences of B4, not a lecture on deciding backwards.
